names: Luís Filipe, Prince Royal of Portugal
summary: Luís Filipe (1887–1908) was the elder son of Carlos I and heir to the Portuguese throne. He was shot in the same carriage as his father crossing the Terreiro do Paço on 1 February 1908 and died within minutes of him. He is in the atlas for the succession that killing redirected: the crown passed to his younger brother, who came to it at eighteen and without preparation.
